full_judgment: 4. The contesting other parties of the said MR case i.e. 2nd & 4th party by filing their written statements claimed their respective title over the disputed land through a sole-decree; by which they claimed that their predecessor had got the said decree by an amicable settlement held among the parties in Title Suit No. 2 of 1956. They also contended that on the basis of the said sole-decree they had also got a separate khatian upon filing separate mutation cases and paid rents thereto. The 5th, 6th and 7th parties in their written statements claimed their possession over the land in dispute by getting lease thereto from the Government. The above contesting parties also contended that the 1st party has/had no title and possession over the disputed land; thus, there has been no cause for drawing up a proceeding under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
